title: DaRon Bland, Donovan Ezeiruaku are expected to be ready for training camp

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: DaRon Bland, Donovan Ezeiruaku are expected to be ready for training camp
sources.description: Cowboys cornerback DaRon Bland and edge rusher Donovan Ezeiruaku aren't practicing with their teammates yet as they continue rehabbing.
